messages:
olivia (People Ops): Quick Q - employee moved from US to UK mid-2025 and we did a payroll cutover shortly after. They stopped 401(k) and HSA on move date. Can we retro remit employer match for deferrals made Jan->move date and how does catch-up (50+) work here? Need any signed auth or vendor constraints?
dan (Payroll): Dates pls - move effective & last US pay and cutover date. In general vendor accepts manual remits with signed auth and payroll export but cutover windows matter.
olivia (People Ops): Move 2025-07-18, last US pay 2025-07-25 (paid), cutover 2025-08-10. Employee turned 50 on 2025-03-04.
dan (Payroll): Ok. We can submit a manual employer match for amounts actually withheld before the move. We need signed employee authorization, ssn_last4, legacy payroll id, and payroll export. Vendor may require quarter cutoff exception if outside normal window.
ryan (Finance): Accounting note: record expense when remitted; attach eligible pay period memo. Legal review if cross-border tax reporting is flagged by vendor. We'll fund GL 6401.
employee (was-ramo): I did elect catch-up earlier this year and had some withheld. Happy to sign doc - pls send what you need.
policy-bot: Policy excerpt: "Employer match is based on elective deferrals actually remitted. Catch-up contributions permitted per plan document. For cutover manual remits, contact payroll@redwood."
olivia (People Ops): Action: I'll collect export and ask employee to sign the manual remit template. Dan - can you open vendor ticket when I post? Ryan - will DM estimated remittance.
dan (Payroll): Yep will open ticket (ref TKT-401K-RETRO-4321) after docs posted.
olivia (People Ops): Thanks all :thumbsup:
